## Code Review

This pull request alphabetically sorts the required properties in several JSON schema files, including pedagogical-visual-block, question-render-model, source-figure-asset, and source-visual-receipt. Additionally, it updates the question-render-asset-contract markdown file by adding an ID column to the checks table and sorting its rows alphabetically, alongside updating the validator results to match. These changes improve consistency and schema readability. As there are no review comments provided, I have no feedback to evaluate.
